Company Description

Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins works with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate. Eurofins believes it is a global leader in food, environmental, pharmaceutical and cosmetics products testing and in agroscience CRO services. It is also one of the global independent market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, CDMO, advanced material sciences and in the support of clinical studies.

In over just 30 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 47,000 staff across a network of more than 900 independent companies in over 50 countries and operating more than 800 laboratories. Eurofins offers a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products, as well as providing innovative clinical diagnostic testing services, as one of the leading global emerging players in specialised clinical diagnostics testing.

 In 2019, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR € 4.56 billion, and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.

Job Description

SUMMARY OF POSITION AND OBJECTIVES:

IT Business Analyst & Power BI / Fabric Developer – Finance Reporting & Analytics is responsible for end-to-end ownership of reporting and analytics solutions within assigned finance domains.

The role combines business analysis and technical delivery responsibilities. The successful candidate will work directly with Finance stakeholders to understand business requirements, identify and assess relevant data sources, design data models, build proof-of-concepts, develop production-grade reporting solutions, and support continuous improvement.

The role requires strong finance process understanding combined with hands-on Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, SQL, and data modelling expertise. The individual will act as a trusted partner for Finance teams and become the primary owner of designated reporting domains.

 

POSITION & OBJECTIVES:

Business Partnership & Demand Management: Act as primary IT partner for designated Finance reporting domains. Collaborate with Finance stakeholders on topics including P&L reporting, balance sheet reporting, cost controlling, budgeting, forecasting, management accounting, and operational finance reporting.

Requirements Analysis: Gather, analyze, document, and challenge business requirements, ensuring clear functional and technical specifications.

Solution Ownership: Own reports, dashboards, KPIs, datasets, and analytics products throughout their lifecycle.

Data Discovery & Integration: Identify source systems and data owners; analyze data structures and define integration requirements.

Architecture & Solution Design: Design scalable reporting solutions aligned with architectural standards and governance requirements.

Data Modelling: Develop semantic models, business calculations, KPIs, and reusable datasets.

Development: Build ETL/ELT components, Fabric artifacts, Power BI reports, dashboards, and analytical solutions.

Proof of Concept Delivery: Rapidly develop prototypes and MVPs to validate business value.

Testing & Validation: Ensure data quality, reconciliation, user acceptance testing, and production readiness.

Documentation: Maintain business requirements, solution documentation, data mappings, KPI definitions, and operating procedures.

Support & Continuous Improvement: Manage enhancements, change requests, and report optimization activities.

 

Qualifications

  • Minimum 4-7 years of experience in BI, analytics, finance systems, or business analysis roles.
  • Strong experience combining business analysis and solution development responsibilities.
  • Hands-on expertise with:
  • Microsoft Fabric,
  • Power BI,
  • SQL,
  • DAX,
  • Data modelling.
  • Solid understanding of finance and controlling processes. Experience with:
  • Microsoft Dynamics AX2012,
  • D365 Finance & Operations,
  • or equivalent ERP solutions.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with finance business users and technical teams.
  • Experience managing reporting products end-to-end.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Fluent English communication skills.

.

Additional Information

Work Environment: The role is transversal and collaborative, interacting with Purchasing, Finance, IT, external Partner and corporate and regional business + IT teams in a multicultural and international environment.

Contract Type: 

This is a fixed-term opportunity, initially for 12 months, with the possibility of an extension for an additional 12 months.

We offer two collaboration options:

  • B2B contract (250 - 270 Euro/day)
  • Fixed-term employment contract  (10.000 - 12.000 Ron net/month)

Standard benefits for fixed-term employment contract in Romania:

  • 13 monthly salaries per year (range 10.000 - 12.000 RON net / month)
  • Meal Vouchers
  • Gym Reimbursement
  • Medical Subscription
  • Health Insurance
  • 25 days of holidays + 1 extra day off for your birthday
  • Additional holidays for your loyalty

Professional Development: Opportunities to enhance and gain practical and solid expertise in Microsoft BI ecosystem and participate in global projects.

Key Attributes: Business-oriented BI professional capable of independently owning reporting domains, translating business requirements into technical solutions, and delivering measurable business value through high-quality analytics products.
